_comment: Status data for the Selling Guide coverage map. The 423 section rows are NOT stored here — they are derived from docs/fannie-mae/selling-guide/section-index.tsv by scripts/selling-guide-coverage.cjs, which FAILS if any id below is not in that index. Anything absent from this file is `unreviewed`, which is the honest default and the whole point of the map.

statuses.implemented: A rule in the Guide is enforced by code on the decision path, named in `evidence`.
statuses.partial: Computed or partially encoded, but not binding on the decision, or missing a documented leg.
statuses.absent: The Guide states a rule that binds us and no code implements it.
statuses.not_applicable: The section governs a function Homiquity does not perform as a broker. Reason required.

notApplicable.reason: Seller/servicer approval. Homiquity never applies to Fannie; the wholesale lender is the seller/servicer.
Maintaining seller/servicer eligibility — not a broker obligation.
Closing legal documents. The wholesale lender closes; we originate and package.
Whole-loan commitments and deliveries to Fannie — seller/servicer function.
MBS pooling and securitization — seller/servicer function.
Fannie's own QC process, run against the seller/servicer, not the originator.

A3-3-01.evidence: No TPO-oversight model in code. This section DEFINES our position: a broker is a third-party originator, and the seller must satisfy itself we produce quality loans. It is the reason the authority gate exists (TEAM_PRACTICES §10).

A3-4-02.evidence: Data quality and integrity is the keystone obligation. Enforced piecemeal (complianceInvariants, the authority gate, audit logging); there is no single control that proves every DU-submitted field is verifiable.

B2-1.2-01.evidence: server/underwritingEngine.ts:381 resolves the CONVENTIONAL_MAX_LTV matrix on the decision path.

B2-2-03.evidence: Financed-property limits exist ONLY as delivery edit shared/fannieMae/loanDeliveryEdits.ts:642 (>6, from a 2020 EarlyCheck workbook) — not as an eligibility rule in the decision path. The Guide is occupancy-conditional: principal residence non-HomeReady no limit, HomeReady 2, second home/investment DU-10. FINDINGS U-23. Table-derived: confirm against the PDF page before coding.

B3-2-01.evidence: server/services/ausSubmission.ts submitToDU is a deterministic simulation. The Guide requires delivery data to match the final DU submission; server/mismo.ts:862 emits a hardcoded "Approve". FINDINGS F-051.

B3-2-02.evidence: DU validation service / Day 1 Certainty relief is parsed in ausSubmission.ts but the asset-verification-report spec is not procured, so the validation legs cannot be adjudicated. Also carries the Asset Verification Report policy that CTO_ROADMAP F14 needs.

B3-2-03.evidence: Carries the positive rent-history policy DU uses (12-month third-party AVR or credit report; one borrower renting >=12 months at >=$300/mo). Nothing consumes it. This is the Selling Guide leg of CTO_ROADMAP F14, now unblocked; the DU Release Notes and AVR spec legs remain absent.

B3-4.1-01.evidence: server/services/preUnderwriting.ts:204 requiredReserveMonths, reached in production ONLY via runPreUnderwriting (dynamic import at server/routes/aus.ts:115 and server/services/loanAnalysis.ts:580). The resulting flags are read by NEITHER decisionEngine.ts NOR underwritingEngine.ts (0 references, verified) — computed and surfaced, not binding. CTO_ROADMAP §3.6.

B3-4.2-02.evidence: server/services/underwritingNuance.ts:371 detectSignificantDeposits, called from preUnderwriting.ts:326 inside derivePreUnderwritingFlags. Same reachability caveat as B3-4.1-01: advisory-only, not read by either engine.

B3-5.1-01.evidence: server/underwritingEngine.ts:342 reads the CONVENTIONAL_FICO_FLOOR policy scalar (620) on the decision path.

B3-5.3-09.evidence: Collection thresholds ($5,000 / >=$250 / >$1,000) carried in data/regulatory/regulatory-ledger.json; tri-bureau pull is simulated. REVISED IN THIS EDITION — the change is Authorized User Tradelines plus a disputed-medical-tradeline note; re-verify before relying on the prior reading.

B3-6-02.evidence: server/underwriting.ts:440 reads CONVENTIONAL_STRETCH_DTI (50%). Platform runs a deliberately stricter 43% baseline overlay (ledger platform-conv-dti-cap-43).

B3-6-05.evidence: server/underwriting.ts assessLiabilities — DEFERRED_STUDENT_LOAN_FACTOR (:301, 1%) and REVOLVING_PAYMENT_FACTOR (:294, greater of $10 or 5%). REVISED IN THIS EDITION.

B3-6-07.evidence: Debts paid off at closing. Was entirely unimplemented until #650 — both branches tested liability types the URLA form cannot emit, so neither could execute while the suite stayed green (conformance ledger C-2). This is the defect class that governs how `evidence` must be written.

B4-2.1-01.evidence: No condo/PUD project review of any kind — `project review` returns 0 hits. Only a condo LLPA adjustment in server/pricing.ts and one risk-flag string. REVISED IN THIS EDITION.

B7-1-02.evidence: server/scripts/seedLendingGrids.ts seeds MI coverage 12/25/30/35% by LTV band; all four bands verified against this section in the conformance ledger.

B7-3-02.evidence: Property and flood insurance requirements. Flood appears only as Special Feature Codes 170/175/180; no flood-zone determination, no coverage-adequacy math. REVISED IN THIS EDITION.

D1-1-01.evidence: Binds the lender, not us — ADOPTED BY CHOICE as the shape of our own quality program, because a wholesale lender's QC must sample our files monthly (QC Review of Third-Party Originations). The routine fleet is that program; Domain Oracle implements the sampling and reporting rules.

B4-1.2-01.evidence: Appraisal Report Forms and Exhibits — the 1004/1073/1007/1025 family. `Form 1004` returns 0 hits across server/shared/client; there is no appraisal-form handling, no UCDP/SSR submission, and the AVM adapter is a deterministic simulation. Appraisal exists only as a fee line and a condition string.

B4-1.3-01.evidence: Review of the Appraisal Report. No appraisal review logic of any kind; `server/services/decisionEngine.ts:373` takes `appraisalValue = propertyValue || purchasePrice`, i.e. it substitutes the contract price for a value nobody reviewed.
